text:
Ivy: Hi team, Ivy here — excited to join! Two quick onboarding security questions: 1) I travel a lot for a few weeks and will be on planes/airport Wi‑Fi — should I enable VPN full-tunnel always, and will that break any streaming I do on breaks? 2) I keep personal backups on an encrypted cloud folder (not company data) — if I enroll my personal Mac in MDM, will that touch my cloud backups?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ivy :tada: Short answers: use VPN full-tunnel on untrusted networks (airports, hotels). It routes all traffic through corporate egress while connected — streaming still works but counts against corporate egress logs. For backups: MDM doesn't upload or read personal cloud backups. Tagging @Omar (Security) for the full details.
Omar (Security): Hi @Ivy — VPN: enable full-tunnel when accessing Slack, internal docs, or repos on untrusted nets. It can impact latency for high-bandwidth streams but won't block them; if you want personal streaming on your phone, use mobile data. About backups: MDM enforces policy and reports OS/version/encryption status only. It won't sync or access your personal cloud files.
Ivy: Thanks — second follow-up: I'm staying at a US APO address for a bit and wondered if Ops can ship a YubiKey + loaner laptop there? Customs sometimes gets weird.
Ops Desk: Hi Ivy — we can ship to APO/FPO but carrier options are limited and delivery takes longer. YubiKeys are considered cryptographic tokens by some carriers; please add a contact phone and allow extra lead time. For APO shipments we usually need APO + unit + PSC fields filled in the hardware form.
Ivy: Noted, I'll add the details. Another thing — I tried to run `fdesetup status` but got permission denied. I'm on a work-profile user on my Mac — any tips?
Omar (Security): If you're seeing permission errors, you might need to run the command with sudo: ```sudo fdesetup status``` — run in Terminal and authenticate. If the device is managed and the command fails, open an IT ticket and include the output.
Ivy: Running with sudo shows "FileVault is Off" — can I enable via System Settings, or is there a company thin-client for enabling FileVault?
Maya (People Ops): You can enable via System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault. If it asks to create a recovery key, choose "Create a recovery key" and save it somewhere safe. If you'd rather have company escrow for the key, put "escrow recovery key" in the hardware form notes and Security will provision it.
Ivy: Perfect. Also curious about phishing sims — will I be included while traveling? I'd rather opt-out for the travel window to avoid accidentally clicking while juggling flights.
Omar (Security): New hires are normally included after day 3. We can pause simulations for the travel window on request. Ask People Ops to note travel dates and we'll set a one-week opt-out. Reporting a simulated email is harmless — it just triggers a short micro-training email.
security-bot: Automated message from security-bot: Phishing simulations originate from simulation@redwood-security.test and include "[Redwood Simulation]" in the subject. Use the report button to flag sims; you will receive a micro-training email. See https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims for sample messages and tips.
Ivy: Awesome, thanks all. I'll submit the laptop + yubikey form with APO details and DM @Maya my travel dates.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Ivy — welcome aboard :rocket: Ops, please confirm international/APO ship ETA when the request comes in. Omar, we'll DM the travel dates for the opt-out.
Ops Desk: Received — we'll queue the APO shipment and confirm carrier options once the form is complete. Expect initial ETA 7–10 business days for APO.
Ivy: Thanks everyone — filing the form now :thumbsup:
